name: Otavalo
tagline: Andean market town among volcanoes and lakes
summary: Otavalo is famous for South America's best-known indigenous market, where Kichwa weavers sell textiles under the Imbabura volcano. Shop the Plaza de los Ponchos, see the dawn animal market on Saturdays, hike around the Cuicocha crater lake, and visit the Peguche waterfall.
seasonNote: Dry season June to September; the big market day is Saturday. Inti Raymi festivities in June.
arrival: About 2 hours by bus from Quito.
cashTip: Ecuador uses US dollars; carry small notes. Tip about 10 percent.
foodTip: Fritada, hornado roast pork, empanadas de viento and bizcochos from Cayambe.
buyTip: Alpaca and wool textiles, and hammocks.
